outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of an H&E histology image and spatial transcriptomics heatmap plots overlaid on tissue sections, not a plot of averaged/aggregated summary data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a set of micrographs (H&E and RNAscope fluorescence images), not a quantitative plot showing averages, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot displaying every individual patient tumor value (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) as separate points, with median and 95% CI shown as summary overlay on top of the raw data.

Panel D shows bar graphs (mean ± SD) with the individual data points (n=3 technical replicates per group) overlaid as dots on each bar, so the underlying data are visible alongside the summary statistic.
